pair.title: Midea LAN
pair.subtitle: Connect your Midea air conditioner to Homey over the local network.
pair.notice: SmartHome is used only during pairing to obtain the local V3 token and key. The password is not stored. Reserve the AC IP address in your router.
pair.ip_hint: Recommended: reserve this address in your router. Leave it empty only to try network discovery.
pair.login_hint: Required for most V3 Wi-Fi modules. The password is not stored after pairing.
pair.advanced_label: Advanced: use an existing V3 token and key
pair.advanced_hint: Use this only when you already have both values backed up.
pair.connect_button: Sign in to SmartHome and find the AC
pair.connecting: Discovering the AC, signing in to SmartHome and verifying the LAN connection…
pair.ready: Enter the IP address and SmartHome credentials.
pair.account_password_required: Enter both the SmartHome account and password.
pair.token_key_required: Enter both the V3 token and key.

repair.title: Repair Midea connection
repair.intro: Update the local IP address and, for V3, obtain a fresh token/key from SmartHome.
repair.hint: Leave SmartHome fields empty when the existing token/key is still valid.
